## A single dose

For each individual, you can execute a single dose. In this example, it's a bolus dose.

- Use the `evtools` plugin
- The dynamic dosing stuff goes in the `[ event ]` block
- Call `evt::bolus()` to create the basic dose
- Then `push()` the object back to mrgsolve


```{c, eval = FALSE, filename = "model/evtools-0.solv", code = readLines("model/evtools-0.solv")}

```

We 
don't pass in a dosing data set; this is executed in the model itself.


```{r}
mod <- mread("model/evtools-0.solv")

out <- mrgsim(mod, end = 48, delta = 0.1)

plot(out)
```
